job.job_description:
Build backend platform components including API services, workflow implementations, and enterprise integrations. Work within a structured team under senior technical guidance
Roles and Responsibilities
Develop REST APIs and backend services per specification
Implement workflow logic using durable workflow engines
Build integrations with enterprise communication and monitoring tools
Write unit and integration tests; maintain code coverage standards
Participate in code reviews and sprint ceremonies
Required Skills
1 3 years backend engineering experience
REST API design and implementation
Git-based workflows and PR practices
Test-driven development fundamentals
Node.js and/or Python
PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database
Basic Docker and containerization knowledge
Nice to have
Exposure to Kafka or message queuing systems
Exposure to Kubernetes or cloud environments (AWS or Azure)
Familiarity with ITSM or enterprise software domains


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
